newsitem.title: USA: Metrowerks sees Q3 revs near $5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Metrowerks sees Q3 revs near $5 mln.

text.p: Metrowerks Inc said on Thursday it expects revenue for its fiscal third quarter to be between $4.8 million and $5.2 million, but added that revenues for the next several quarters would be more volatile and less predictable.
The company's third quarter ends in July.

Among factors that could contribute to volatility in later quarters, the company mentioned "possible non-recurring engineering contracts, and new product sales which may or may not occur, or may not occur in the time-frame estimated by management."
Metrowerks makes programming tools for building applications for certain operating systems.
